name: Corporate Action Proceeds Delivery Instruction
definition: Specifies the delivery instructions for the securities and cash proceeds at any stage of the Corporate Action process.

RelatedDistribution.name: Related Distribution
RelatedDistribution.definition: Parameters of the distribution of the proceeds of a CA event.

SecuritiesProceedsMovement.name: Securities Proceeds Movement
SecuritiesProceedsMovement.definition: Instructions for the movement of securities related to a corporate action.

CashProceedsMovement.name: Cash Proceeds Movement
CashProceedsMovement.definition: Instructions for the movement of cash related to a corporate action.

SettlementAccount.name: Settlement Account
SettlementAccount.definition: Information relative to the account(s) to be used for the delivery of the proceeds (cash or securities)

CorporateActionStandingInstruction.name: Corporate Action Standing Instruction
CorporateActionStandingInstruction.definition: Standing instruction related to a corporate action.
